scope.summary: Consolidate the legacy generate_avatar_pose MCP surface into a compatibility adapter over canonical BodyPose proposal/preview/apply authority, with no second pose table or event truth.
acceptance_criteria: The legacy wire tool translates keyword/reference inputs into the MT-399/MT-600 canonical proposal workflow and returns its preview/apply receipt; it does not create tailor_avatar_poses or a second PoseSpec store.
Any pre-existing legacy pose records are read-only migration inputs that deterministically upgrade into canonical BodyPose assets with source lineage and a one-time compatibility receipt.
Built-in fallback produces an explicit A-pose proposal requiring preview/selected apply; LlmClient failure never silently commits fallback state.
Schema generation, cancellation, wrong-character, stale-base, replay, and duplicate-request paths prove compatibility without duplicate events.
scope.risk_if_missed: Keeping a second pose table/tool truth would make UI, MCP, replay, and collision snapshots disagree about the active pose.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior remains observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; GUI projection is verified by the owning native-shell MT.

target_entries: Tailor model manual > Legacy generate_avatar_pose compatibility

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The implementing MT must emit or project its applicable Tailor lifecycle, command, job, validation, or authority event through the shared Flight Recorder contract; pure solver kernels surface typed receipts through their owning run.
The shared internal_diagnostics substrate is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; this MT must use its open projection contract when available and must not fork a Tailor-only diagnostics runtime.
The shared Palmistry watcher is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; long-running Tailor jobs inherit bounded child-stall and survivor coverage during the retrofit.

required_changes_before_execution: Consolidate with MT-399 and canonical MT-600 pose_body; no second pose truth or direct tailor_avatars mutation.
Added gui_obligation, user_manual_obligation, and HBR-INT-009 tier obligations from the current MT template without removing original scope.
